payment.fallback_template: Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt of a correct invoice.

liability.fallback_template: Each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.

sla.fallback_template: Service credits shall be Customer's sole remedy for service level failures and shall not exceed ten percent (10%) of the monthly fees in aggregate.

confidentiality.fallback_template: The confidentiality obligations shall survive termination of this Agreement for a period of not less than two (2) years.

termination.fallback_template: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon not less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice.

ip.fallback_template: All Deliverables created under this Agreement shall be the sole and exclusive property of Customer upon payment.
